ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to 20% high-intensity (white/light-grey) distribution across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white patches are localized on the distal regions of both lobes. The left lobe features a small, sub-triangular white patch at the tip. The right lobe features a larger, more complex white patch with several internal low-intensity linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an approximate vertex angle of 120 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 12% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant peak-to-valley pixel amplitude is visible, particularly on the distal margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges of both lobes exhibit a macro-level convex sweep from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated dark circular clusters are visible at the extreme distal edge and within the white region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of multiple dark linear streaks (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the high-intensity white patch on the right lobe's ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake marks on the right lobe; irregular jagged indentations and deep notches along the trailing edge consistent with physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific hook-like protrusion and associated dark cluster on the distal-most edge of the right fluke tip.
